paragraphs.text: 给你的 DSH agent 一个能跨模型延续的自我：分层记忆、判断卡、交接包、压缩审查。零依赖、纯文件、可迁移。
﻿# qing-self

> A scaffold that gives a DSH agent or role **layered memory + judgment cards +
> model handoff + co

mpression review** in one command — structure only, no content.
> No third-party judgments, no priva
te memories, no hidden behavior.
> **Renamed:** `dsh-self` → `dsh-memory-scaffold` (v0.2.0) → **`qing-self`** (v0.3.0). The CLI binar
y is still `dsh-self`; slash commands, agent tools, `.dsh-self/` paths and format schemas are unchan
still `dsh-self`; slash commands, agent tools, `.dsh-self/` paths and format schemas are unchanged.

- Zero dependencies, no network, no LLM calls, no embeddings
- Plain markdown + JSON that any editor

can read, diff and migrate
- Every command supports `--json`; the on-disk format is published and l

ocked,
so other plugins can read it and build on it
- Versioned templates (`template=v1.0.0` + CHANG

ELOG); upgrades never overwrite
user files
## Install in 30 seconds
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH when prompted, then run `/self-init` in a workspace.
**What it does:** gives a DSH agent a structure that survives model/session swaps — layered memory f
iles, judgment cards, a full handoff package with 8 verification questions and a 6–10 KB compact mod
e, and a two-question ruler for transferability and recoverability. **Structure only, not a memory e
ngine:** it does not capture chats, embed, retrieve or call a model.
## Why it exists

The DSH ecosystem already has many memory plugins (storage, retrieval, sidebars,
automatic capture).

What most users still lack is a **decision about structure**:
which files to keep, what goes in eac

h, when to write, when to compact, and what
to hand over when switching models.

This package is not another store. It is the **skeleton and ritual**: four files,
five operations, a

nd a machine-readable contract that other plugins can integrate
with.
## What you get
| Command | What it does |
| `init` | Creates the four-layer structure — `hot/state.md`, `index.md`, `judgments.md`, `judgments
-cards.md`, `decisions.md` — plus templates and a `QUICKSTART.md`. Idempotent: adds missing files, *

*never overwrites** what you wrote. |
| `judge` | Adds one judgment card: conclusion / why / failure
-counterexample / unfinished / source. Auto-numbered (J001…), written to both the index table and th

e card file. |
| `handoff` | Reads your memory, writes a continuation package plus **8 verification
questions**, and a machine-readable `.json` sidecar for other plugins. Run it before switching model
or session. `--compact` emits a 6–10 KB package (direction + hot + condensed live judgments + `--fo

cus` cards + pending + questions); `--focus` selects judgment cards by topic. |
| `review` | Compres
sion review: hot size (>800 chars / >2 KB warning), context-share estimate, not-yet-persisted items,

judgments/cards consistency, broken index pointers, template drift. |
| `ruler` | The two-question
ruler: turns a judgment into two concrete follow-ups — would it survive another version of me (trans
ferability), and could it be recovered if I forgot everything tomorrow (continuability) — plus a cop
yable prompt for any AI and the biggest risk. Local template + keyword heuristic — **zero model call
s, no network, no writes**. |
### Two-question ruler: transferability × continuability (no model calls)
Use the ruler before turning an insight into a judgment. It turns **your** wording into two concrete
follow-ups instead of repeating borrowed wisdom:
1. **Transferability**: would this judgment still hold if another version of me used it? Which resou

rces / time /
environment / model conditions does it depend on? If it only holds for "me at that mom

ent", it is a situation,
not a judgment.
2. **Continuability**: if I forgot everything tomorrow, cou

ld this judgment be picked up again — written down and
recoverable by the next version, or only "I r
emember"? Memory disappears with the body.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

It also returns one line for the biggest risk and a fenced **copyable prompt** you can paste into
an
y AI (or answer yourself). DSH users get the same through `/self-ruler` and `dsh_self_ruler`.

Use it for: irreversible decisions, promises with a cost, evaluating someone, spending money or
aski

ng someone to bear a consequence. It deliberately does **not** call a model, use the network or
writ
e any memory file — the judgment stays yours (or the AI you paste it into).
## What it is not

- **Not a store/retrieval plugin**: no auto-capture, no embeddings, no prompt
injection, no context

manipulation.
- **Not a content pack**: templates contain placeholders only. Identity,
judgments and

relationship history are yours to write.
- **Not a runtime**: a deterministic file scaffold and che

cker; the CLI works
without DSH (plain Node).
## Positioning and moat

1. **Format lock (soft)**: directory layout, table columns, status enum, card
field names and machin

e markers are fixed in `docs/FORMAT.md`. Third-party
plugins that want compatibility must follow the

format — this creates a
de facto standard, but there is **no encryption, no hidden marker, no
exclu

sivity logic**: users can move, edit and migrate their memory freely.
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy and security

- Memory is **plain, unencrypted text** readable by any local process. Never
store passwords/tokens/

ID numbers; store a pointer to where they live.
- The package makes **no network calls, no telemetry

**; `--json` writes to
stdout and local files only.
- Whether the memory directory belongs in git is
the user's decision.
## Known limitations

- Does not inject context automatically (that is another plugin's job; this
package provides the str

ucture)
- Context share is a **character-budget estimate**, not a platform measurement
(calibrate wi

th `--context-budget`)
- Assumes a **single writer**; do not write one memory directory concurrently

from several processes
- Template upgrades are manual by design (no automatic rewrite)
- Only forma

t v1; no cross-version migrator yet (unknown versions fail loudly
with `UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT`)
- Not p

ublished to npm / a plugin marketplace yet (delivery form: local directory
install); the GUI panel i
s intentionally out of scope per the product spec
